_README: Writing/blog manifest. Each item appears as a row on /writing.html. Each post lives in /writing/posts/<slug>.html.
_HOW_TO_ADD: 2) Add an entry below: slug, title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), excerpt, tags[].
3) Save & refresh /writing.html. Posts sort by date descending.
4) The post HTML can use any styling — link back to /writing.html with a 'back' button.

items.title: From Data Encoder to Backend Dev — The Long Way Around
items.excerpt: Five years ago I was typing logs into spreadsheets at a TV relay station. Today I design REST APIs for a SaaS platform. Here's what the slow path taught me.

items.title: What RxFY Taught Me About Shipping Real Software
items.excerpt: My thesis was a real-time monitoring system for antibiotic purchases. The grade was good. The lessons were better — most of them about the parts of software that aren't code.

items.title: Hardware Habits That Made Me a Better Software Engineer
items.excerpt: Soldering doesn't translate to typescript. But the mindset of working with embedded systems — finite resources, no easy retries, and read the datasheet — turns out to fix a lot of bad software habits too.

items.title: Hello, World — Why I Started This Site
items.excerpt: A quick note on why I rebuilt my portfolio, what I want it to do for me, and what's next on the roadmap.
